document out lines the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every 
five years as indicated by Y5 in the above title block.

glands exhaust of turbine.

The first 
draft initiated and tested by eng. Mohammed Abd El-Kader, accepted by 
eng. Mohammed Farag: maintenance manager, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality 
control eng. Smir Abd El-Gelil, and approved by eng. Fathy Mahmuod

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety ID category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required,

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
 safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the fan motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the fan motor.

The fan must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 delivery and suction valves.
Be sure fan must be completely drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller, Rags
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight edge.

Checks discharge quantity and pressure and 
 record them.

Check the vibration level of the fan set 
 complete with the motor then, record them
Remove the protective cover of the coupling.
Check alignment between motor and fan.
Shift electric motor away from the coupling.

Disconnect suction mouth and flange of cover 
 on a spiral box.

Remove covers of the bearing brackets after 
 unscrewing the locking nut.

Dismantling the bearings with a removable 
 tapered (sleeve adapter or a tapered sleeve is as easy as their fitting).

Take out carefully the whole rotor from spiral 
 box and shift it towards the motor.

loose the bolt tightening impeller on a shaft 
 .

Pull down the impeller by a puller (the 
 puller will be fixed in two threaded holes in the impeller hub) and hang it 
 onto a hoisting equipment .

Pull down the coupling half from the shaft 
 with a puller.

List of defects found out during the fan 
 operation.

The 
 validity of the anti-friction ball bearings.
Check all parts for any worn-out and replace them by new ones.
Inspect the run-out of shafts (allowance 0.03 mm).

Smear all threads with grease or with MOLYKA, if it is working in aggressive 
 environment and in fan located on open air sites.
Mounting the impeller on the shaft end of the fan.
Tighten firmly runner nut.

Install the bearings with a removable tapered in their position on the clean 
 shaft.
Mounting the coupling half on the shaft
Mounting carefully whole rotor in the spiral box and tighten it.

Adjusting the axial clearance of fan by shifting the whole rotor and fixed it 
 with space washer.
Install the covers of the bearings and seal them against the bracket.
Connecting the suction mouth and flange of cover on a spiral box.

After completing the assembly alignment the flexible coupling of the fan and 
 the motor (allowance 0.05 mm).
Put the protective cover of the coupling

Check the direction of rotation of fan before starting the fan for the first 
 time.
Check the quantity of grease in the bearings sump.
Check whether the delivery sluice valve is closed.

Open the delivery valve gradually after the set has been started to operate at 
 its full speed.

The temperature of the anti-friction bearing in the bearing top which should 
 not exceed 75C.
The vibration level of the fan set complete with the motor.
The discharge quantity and pressure.

Introduction
This 
document out lines the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every 
five years as indicated by Y5 in the above title block.
The function of this fan to draw off steam air mixture of steam 
glands exhaust of turbine.
Technical specification:
Design Horizontal 
Centrifugal 
Fan
Fan capacity 
0.4 m3/s
Pressure 5130 Pa
Fan speed 2900 rpm
Bearing type 2311K ( clamping bush 
H2311 )
The first 
draft initiated and tested by eng. Mohammed Abd El-Kader, accepted by 
eng. Mohammed Farag: maintenance manager, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality 
control eng. Smir Abd El-Gelil, and approved by eng. Fathy Mahmuod 
Ragap: head sector of Talkha 2x210 PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control's general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman 
 EDEPC planning & financial predicting head sector and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety ID category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required,
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
 safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the fan motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the fan motor.
The fan must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 delivery and suction valves.
Be sure fan must be completely drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller, Rags
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight edge.
Work to be Carried Out
Fan in 
Operation
Checks discharge quantity and pressure and 
 record them.
Check the vibration level of the fan set 
 complete with the motor then, record them
Fan out 
of Operation
Remove the protective cover of the coupling.
Check alignment between motor and fan.
Shift electric motor away from the coupling.
Disconnect suction mouth and flange of cover 
 on a spiral box.
Remove covers of the bearing brackets after 
 unscrewing the locking nut.
Dismantling the bearings with a removable 
 tapered (sleeve adapter or a tapered sleeve is as easy as their fitting).
Take out carefully the whole rotor from spiral 
 box and shift it towards the motor.
loose the bolt tightening impeller on a shaft 
 .
Pull down the impeller by a puller (the 
 puller will be fixed in two threaded holes in the impeller hub) and hang it 
 onto a hoisting equipment .
Pull down the coupling half from the shaft 
 with a puller.
List of defects found out during the fan 
 operation.
Inspection
The 
 validity of the anti-friction ball bearings.
Check all parts for any worn-out and replace them by new ones.
Inspect the run-out of shafts (allowance 0.03 mm).
Assembly
Smear all threads with grease or with MOLYKA, if it is working in aggressive 
 environment and in fan located on open air sites.
Mounting the impeller on the shaft end of the fan.
Tighten firmly runner nut.
Install the bearings with a removable tapered in their position on the clean 
 shaft.
Mounting the coupling half on the shaft
Mounting carefully whole rotor in the spiral box and tighten it.
Adjusting the axial clearance of fan by shifting the whole rotor and fixed it 
 with space washer.
Install the covers of the bearings and seal them against the bracket.
Connecting the suction mouth and flange of cover on a spiral box.
After completing the assembly alignment the flexible coupling of the fan and 
 the motor (allowance 0.05 mm).
Put the protective cover of the coupling
Starting of Fan
Check the direction of rotation of fan before starting the fan for the first 
 time.
Check the quantity of grease in the bearings sump.
Check whether the delivery sluice valve is closed.
Open the delivery valve gradually after the set has been started to operate at 
 its full speed.
Attendance and checking during Operation
The temperature of the anti-friction bearing in the bearing top which should 
 not exceed 75C.
The vibration level of the fan set complete with the motor.
The discharge quantity and pressure.
